text: Trekking across the North York Moors, American students David Kessler and Jack Goodman leave the Slaughtered Lamb pub and [stray from the road onto the moors|trigger|breaking a rule], where a beast mauls Jack to death. David wakes in a London hospital, visited by [Jack's decaying ghost, stuck in limbo until the bloodline is severed|wants|release and unfinished business], who urges him to die before the full moon. In nurse Alex Price's flat he [painfully transforms into a werewolf|rules|the body changes], prowls the London Underground [killing six people|who_suffers|whole communities], and wakes naked in a wolf enclosure at the zoo.
